Spectris is a leading company in the test and measurement area, and they are seeking a RedHawk Software Engineer to develop world-class Linux RTOS software and real-time tools. The role involves executing project objectives, performing complex engineering tasks, and contributing to product design, development, and support.
Industrial
Mechanical Engineering
Industrial Engineering
No H1B
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
You will develop, enhance, validate, and support Concurrent's RedHawk real-time enhanced Linux kernels and tools, working with both larger server-class systems that utilize standard Linux distributions, and smaller embedded hardware modules that utilize embedded Linux environments
You will also develop, enhance, validate, and support Concurrent's KVM-RT real-time virtualization engine to ensure that both real-time hosts and real-time virtual machines continue to achieve the highest level of determinism and lowest latencies in the industry
You will also periodically work on various projects including performance analysis, benchmarking, release engineering, security hardening, white paper authoring, quality assurance, and assisting with our automated nightly test system
Assess and determine areas of current engineering emphasis to focus attention on maximum utilization of engineering capabilities
Translate future product needs into engineering feasibility and be aware of product and project issues across multiple engineering disciplines
Consider all systems level aspects of products in accomplishing the most complex conceptual and innovative design projects
Employ all required section equipment, tools and methods
Contribute to improving the technical knowledge base and effectiveness of other engineers
Interface with co-workers and staff from other departments and ensure positive working relationship
Impart technical expertise within department, and to customers, users’ groups
Qualification
Linux RTOS
C
C++
Bash scripting
Linux
Operating system fundamentals
Virtualization
Required
Must be a US Citizen
Passionate about computer engineering
Self-directed, self-motivated, and detail-oriented
In-depth and diversified technical knowledge in engineering and process tasks
Experience in developing, enhancing, validating, and supporting Linux RTOS software
Experience with both Intel/AMD and ARM64 architectures
Good foundations in C and C++ with experience from working on individual projects
Familiarity with Bash scripting and Linux in general
Classwork and/or knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including virtualization
Benefits
10% yearly bonus
Freedom with responsibility is the framework for HBK’s employees. This allows for a good balance between work and family life and for constant development of professional and personal skills in an international and enjoyable working environment.
